name: Default
shortDescription: Open source LLMOps and agent platform with a prompt playground, evaluations, observability and an agent runner, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis, SeaweedFS and SuperTokens.

alerts.message: There is no default login: sign up with an email and password on first visit. Until you set AGENTA_ACCESS_ALLOWED_DOMAINS or AGENTA_ACCESS_ALLOWED_OWNER_EMAILS, anyone who can reach the URL can sign up and run custom code evaluators and agents on this server.
Prompts, evaluations and agents need an LLM provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic and others), added in the Agenta settings after sign-up.
The agent runner runs without FUSE, so each agent run gets a fresh working directory that does not persist across turns.
